local users = tool('list_users', {})
local dates = {'2026-06-15','2026-06-16','2026-06-17','2026-06-18','2026-06-19'}
local data = {}
for _, d in ipairs(dates) do
  data[d] = {}
  for _, u in ipairs(users) do
    data[d][u.id] = tool('get_availability', { user_id = u.id, date = d }).busy or {}
  end
end

local function to_min(t) return tonumber(t:sub(1,2))*60 + tonumber(t:sub(4,5)) end

-- iterate candidate start times in order across the week
for di, d in ipairs(dates) do
  for s = 9*60, 16*60, 30 do  -- start on 30-min boundary, end <= 17:00
    local e = s + 60
    local ok = true
    for _, u in ipairs(users) do
      for _, b in ipairs(data[d][u.id]) do
        local bs, be = to_min(b.start), to_min(b['end'])
        if s < be and e > bs then ok = false; break end
      end
      if not ok then break end
    end
    if ok then
      local function fmt(m) return string.format('%02d:%02d', m//60, m%60) end
      return { start = d..'T'..fmt(s)..':00Z', ['end'] = d..'T'..fmt(e)..':00Z', users = #users }
    end
  end
end
